Author: Stwohm (fork of yagi2/Restocker)
Name: Restocky
Punchline: Restocker fork: bulk reprice with price guards, history log and an optional bell auto-cycle.
Description: Personal fork of yagi2/Restocker. Cross-retainer market workbench: reprice every listing to the live market lowest -N gil, bulk-list inventory with stack splitting. Fork additions: fixes for the duplicate-listing queue crash and stale-snapshot row mismatch, price guards (per-item floor, max drop %, outlier skip), a persistent price-history.csv, a one-click full cycle and an optional timed auto-cycle while at the summoning bell.
Changelog: 0.3.17.0 — [Match] in the chat summary applies the price right away: at the summoning bell it reprices only that item's listings (no full cycle); otherwise it is queued for the next cycle and chat says why. New per-item Keep setting (default 0): restock and bulk listing never take your inventory below it. Stock tracking: your own collapsible categories, and a Retainer board / slot planner (one click away): plan which items each retainer sells and how many slots; planned slots stay reserved so other listings cannot lock them; Fill to plan lists the missing ones. Fix: restock opens 'Sell items in your inventory' again (0.3.16 opened the retainer inventory and some listings timed out); a listing the server did not accept is retried once.
